name: prospective 48-corpus Fourier expansion
status: pilot-derived hypothesis frozen before any expansion-corpus training outcome
scientific_scope: prospective replication of the post-v3.1 observation that Fourier-CE overlap improves an ordinary entropy/compression baseline

measurement_protocol.reason: retain identical data splits, model training, validation, Fourier profiles, and response surface

development_panel.role: fit the two frozen OLS predictors

expansion_panel.role: prospective source-disjoint evaluation of predictions frozen from the 24-corpus development panel

primary_comparison.model: standardized unpenalized OLS with architecture and source-stratum fixed effects
primary_comparison.prediction_unit: corpus-architecture median over two training seeds
primary_comparison.motivation_disclosure: selected after the v3.1 pilot because it improved grouped LOCO RMSE by 2.04%; this is a new prospective claim, not the original v3.1 confirmation

secondary_comparison.status: descriptive replication of the failed v3.1 gate

decision.resample: corpora within source stratum, retaining all five architectures
decision.success: paired relative RMSE improvement interval for primary Fourier model strictly above zero
